_comment: Every sentence the setup shows or logs. Ids: step.*, phase.<step>.<phase>, state.*, reason.*, result.*, component.*, preset.*, msg.*, warn.*, err.*. {name} is a parameter. A translation is text/<lang>.json with the same ids (missing ones fall back to this file); --lang <lang> selects it.
step.check: Checking this PC and your disc
step.prompts_font: Setting the Xbox prompts and the modern font
result.failed: Stopped. Nothing finished so far is lost: run the setup again to continue.
result.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing finished so far is lost: run the setup again to continue.
component.prompts_font: Xbox button prompts and modern font
component.textures.desc: Every picture in the game upscaled four times by AI on your graphics card.
component.movies.desc: The 89 cutscenes upscaled to 1080p by AI on your graphics card.
component.prompts_font.desc: Xbox-style button names and a sharp modern font. Nothing to build; you can change both in the game's menu.
preset.faithful.desc: The game as it was, nothing extra.
preset.recommended.desc: The game, HD textures, and the modern font with Xbox prompts.
preset.everything.desc: Recommended, and the HD movies (the longest part).
msg.plan_download: Download {name} ({mb} MB) from {url} into {dest}. It must have the SHA-256 {sha256}, or it is thrown away. Licence: {license}.
msg.plan_nothing: Everything chosen is already in place; nothing to do.
msg.plan_disk: Disk space needed: {need}; {final} stays when the temporary files are gone.
msg.plan_disk_hd: Disk space needed: {need} (the HD builder alone peaks at {peak}); {final} stays when the temporary files are gone.
msg.plan_time: Time on a fast PC with a recent graphics card: {min} to {max} minutes. A weaker graphics card takes several times longer.
msg.time_note: Measured on the author's PC (Ryzen 9 7900X, RTX 5070 Ti); the graphics card decides the HD parts.
phase.source.convert: Converting the image to an ISO
phase.source.validate: Checking the disc image against the known dump
warn.output_changed: What the {step} step made earlier has changed since: it will be done again.
warn.dest_not_program_folder: {dest} is not the folder this setup runs from ({program}). This check goes on, but a real install into another folder is not supported yet.
warn.hd_no_vulkan: HD textures and HD movies need a graphics card with Vulkan, and this PC has no Vulkan driver. They are left out; the game itself installs and plays without them. Update the graphics driver and run the setup again to add them.
warn.hd_no_gpu: HD textures and HD movies need a graphics card (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel Arc) with Vulkan, and only {devices} was found. They are left out; the game itself installs and plays without them.
err.usage: The command line is not right: {detail}.
err.internal: The setup hit an unexpected problem ({exception}: {detail}). The log file has the details.
err.state_unreadable: {path} cannot be read. It records what an earlier setup finished; move it away to start over (nothing in the game's folders is deleted).
err.state_newer: {path} was written by a newer setup than this one. Use the newer setup.
err.python_old: This needs Python 3.11 or newer; this is {version}.
err.windows_64: The game needs 64-bit Windows 10 or later.
err.cpu_sse41: This processor lacks SSE4.1, which the game needs.
err.dest_foreign: {dest} already holds other files, and they are not a Rogue Galaxy install. Choose an empty folder.
err.dest_not_program_folder: This setup builds the game in the folder it runs from ({program}); {dest} is another folder. Run the setup from the folder you want to install into.
err.path_network: The game cannot be built in a network folder. Move the whole folder to a local drive.
err.path_onedrive: The game cannot be built inside OneDrive, which would upload the 10 GB the build writes. Move the folder out of it.
err.path_long: This folder's path is too long for the build tools ({length} characters; at most {max}). Move it to a short path such as C:\RogueGalaxy.
err.path_chars: This folder's path has spaces, accented letters or symbols, which the build tools mishandle. Move it to a path such as C:\RogueGalaxy.
err.source_required: The setup needs your disc: pass --source with your disc image (.iso, .bin/.cue, .chd) or an extracted disc folder.
err.source_missing: There is no file or folder {path}.
err.source_type: {path} is not a disc image the setup knows. It reads .iso, .bin/.cue and .chd files, and a folder with the disc's files.
err.disc_not_iso: {path} is not a readable PlayStation 2 disc image ({detail}).
err.disc_not_ps2: This does not look like a PlayStation 2 disc: it has no SYSTEM.CNF.
err.disc_region: This is a different disc: {serial} ({region}). Only the {expected_region} release, {expected}, is supported for now.
err.disc_mismatch: This is not a complete, unchanged copy of Rogue Galaxy (USA, SCUS-97490): {count} of its files are wrong or missing ({missing} missing, {wrong} different). First: {first}. Dump the disc again, or choose another copy.
err.disc_image_hash: The disc image's {algo} is {got}, but the known dump has {expected}. Dump the disc again.
err.disc_folder_not_disc: {path} does not hold a PlayStation 2 disc's files: there is no SYSTEM.CNF in it or in a single folder inside it.
err.disc_cue: The CUE sheet cannot be used: {detail}.
err.disc_bin_size: The image is {size} bytes, but the USA disc is {expected}. It is a different or incomplete dump.
err.disc_bin_sector: Sector {sector} of the image is damaged or not what the CUE sheet says (no CD sync pattern). Dump the disc again.
err.chd_unreadable: {path} cannot be read as a CHD ({detail}).
err.chd_extract: chdman could not turn the CHD into an ISO ({detail}).
err.space: There is not enough free space on {drive}: this needs about {need} GB and {free} GB are free. Free some space, or install on another drive.
err.space_temp: There is not enough free space for the temporary files in {temp}: about {need} GB are needed and {free} GB are free. Use --temp to choose another drive.
err.consent_needed: These downloads need your yes first: {names}. Run again with --yes (or answer y when asked).
err.download_failed: Downloading {name} failed: {detail}. Check the internet connection and run the setup again.
err.download_hash: The file downloaded for {name} is not the expected one (its SHA-256 differs), so it was thrown away and nothing was unpacked. Run the setup again; if it repeats, something on this network alters downloads.
err.tool_missing: {exe} is missing from {name} after unpacking. An antivirus may have removed it: restore it from quarantine (or allow {dir}) and run the setup again.
err.extract_failed: Unpacking the disc failed ({detail}). Free disk space is the usual cause.
err.extract_hash: {count} files came out different from the known disc (first: {first}). The source is damaged; dump the disc again.
err.game_running: The game is running (process {pids}), and Windows will not let the setup replace it. Close the game and run the setup again.
err.sources_missing: thirdparty/PS2Recomp or thirdparty/imgui is empty. GitHub's "Source code" download leaves them out: download the release zip instead.
err.build_failed: Building the game stopped in the {phase} phase ({detail}). The full output is in {log}. Run the setup again to continue from where it stopped.
err.build_no_exe: The build finished but {exe} is not there. An antivirus may have removed it.
err.hd_needs_disc: The HD builder reads the unpacked disc, and disc/ does not hold it yet.
err.hd_failed: The HD builder stopped at "{step}": {what} {hint} The full output is in {log}. Run the setup again to continue: finished work is kept.
err.pip_failed: Installing numpy and Pillow failed ({detail}). Check the internet connection and run the setup again.
